```text
- Cache migration
    ▸ Reads
        ↪ Median read latency fell from 40 ms to 12 ms.
    ▸ Writes
        i. Quorum writes
            ↪ Each write waits for two replicas.
    ▸ Decision
        ↪ The team chose quorum writes over speed.
```

```text
- Queue migration
    ▸ Writes
        ↪ Producers write to one primary.
```
